hack.root_cause: Flash loan + Curve 3pool spot price manipulation → vault share price arbitrage → DAI drain during migration
hack.description: Yearn's yDAI vault lost $11M when attackers exploited a migration window where withdrawal fees were zeroed — flash loans turned a routine vault migration into a $2.7M payday.
